title: Cash and bank
description: The business's tills, bank accounts and online payment receivables: balances, movements, transfers and daily closings.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view cash and bank accounts.
load_failed: Accounts could not be loaded. Try again.
empty_description: Add a branch till, a bank account or an online payment account; collections and expenses are posted to them.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters or clear the search.
create_description: Open a till, bank or online payment account for a branch or the whole business.
edit_description: Update the account's name and details. Branch and kind cannot change later.
detail_description: Balance, movements, daily closings and history.
detail_not_found: The account was not found or you have no access.
columns.name: Account
fields.branch_hint: Whole business: a head-office till or a shared bank account; only members with every branch see it.
fields.fixed_hint: Fixed once the account is opened.
fields.kind_hint: A till cannot go negative and has a daily closing; bank and online accounts can go negative.
fields.name: Account name
fields.name_hint: For example: Main till, Business current account, Stripe.
fields.sort_order_hint: Lower numbers come first in lists.
fields.opening_balance_hint: The balance on the opening date. Cannot be negative for a till.
fields.opening_locked: Locked because the account has movements.
fields.movement_date_hint: Cannot be in the future or on a closed day.
fields.description_hint: Why the money moved; shown in the cash book.
fields.counted_amount_hint: The cash actually counted in the till.
form.section_identity_desc: Branch, kind, name and opening balance.
form.section_details_desc: Bank details, payment provider and note.
detail.closing_hint: No movements on or before this day.
movements.title: Cash book
movements.description: Movements of every account. Movements are never deleted or edited; a mistake is corrected with a reversal.
movements.load_failed: Movements could not be loaded. Try again.
movements.empty_description: Money in, money out and transfers on any account show up here.
movements.empty_account_description: No money has moved on this account yet.
closing.empty_description: Count the till at the end of the day and close it; the difference is booked and the day is locked.
movement_dialog.title: Money in / out
transfer_dialog.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer_dialog.description: Like a till deposit to the bank or a provider payout. A transfer is not revenue.
transfer_dialog.description_hint: For example: Daily bank deposit, provider payout.
closing_dialog.title: Daily closing
closing_dialog.description: Count the {{name}} till; the difference is booked and the day is locked.
closing_dialog.last_closed: Last closing: {{date}}. Pick a later day.
reverse_dialog.title: Reverse movement
reverse_dialog.description: The movement is not deleted; its opposite is booked today and the balance is corrected.
reverse_dialog.description_transfer: Both legs of the transfer are reversed with today's date.
reopen_dialog.title: Reopen closing
reopen_dialog.description: The {{date}} closing is reopened and its difference reversed. The reason is recorded.
daily.title: Daily summary
daily.description: Opening, money in, money out, transfers and closing per account for the chosen day.
validation.amount: Enter a valid amount (at most 2 decimals).
validation.amount_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
validation.cash_opening_negative: A till cannot open with a negative balance.
validation.sort_order: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100000.
validation.reason_min: Write a reason of at least 3 characters.
detail.period_closing_hint: A period closes after the statement is reconciled; no movement may be dated on or before the closed day.
closing.empty_description_period: Close the period once the statement lines are matched; the difference is booked and the period is locked.
closing_dialog.period_description: Compare the book balance of {{name}} with the statement balance; the difference is booked and the period is locked.
closing_dialog.unreconciled: {{count}} statement lines up to this day are pending or in difference. Match, post or ignore them first.
fields.statement_amount_hint: Balance the bank statement or provider panel shows at the end of this day.
fields.statement_source_hint: A bank statement or the settlement report of an online payment provider.
fields.statement_name_hint: For example: June 2026 statement, iyzico week 24 settlement.
fields.closing_balance_hint: Balance the document states at the period end; compared with the book balance.
fields.fee_hint: Commission the provider withheld on this line; booked as an expense when the line is matched.
fields.reference_hint: Receipt or transaction number; a repeated reference on the same account is refused.
statements.columns.name: Statement
statements.empty_description_bank: Import the bank statement (CSV/XLSX); lines are matched with the book and the missing ones posted.
statements.empty_description_provider: Import the provider's settlement report; payments, fees and payouts are matched with the book.
statements.detail_description: Match the lines with the book, post the missing movements and close the period.
statements.not_found: Statement not found or no access.
statements.closed_description: This statement is locked by the account's period closing. Reopen the closing to change it.
statements.summary.closing_balance_hint: Enter the document's closing balance; the difference shows here.
lines.load_failed: Lines could not be loaded. Try again.
lines.empty_description: Import the statement or add a line; movements of the same amount on a nearby date match automatically.
match_dialog.title: Match with a book movement
match_dialog.empty_description: No movement on the same account and direction within ±15 days. Post the line to the book or ignore it.
match_dialog.difference_warning: The amounts differ by {{amount}}. The line is marked as a difference; refresh the match once the book is corrected.
post_dialog.title: Post to book
post_dialog.fee_hint: The {{amount}} fee is booked separately as an expense.
post_dialog.payout_hint: A payout is a transfer between two accounts; pick the counter account.
post_dialog.counter_hint: Active accounts in the same currency.
post_dialog.description_hint: Defaults to the line's description or reference.
statement_dialog.title: New statement
statement_dialog.description: A document of {{name}}. Lines are imported on the statement page.
line_dialog.title: Add line
line_dialog.description: Add a line to {{name}} by hand.
delete_statement_dialog.title: Delete statement
delete_statement_dialog.description: {{name}} and all its lines are deleted. A statement with posted lines cannot be deleted.
reset_line_dialog.title: Remove match
reset_line_dialog.description: The line goes back to pending; the book movement is untouched.
reset_line_dialog.description_fee: The line goes back to pending; the fee expense booked on match is reversed.
ignore_line_dialog.title: Ignore line
ignore_line_dialog.description: The line is not posted and does not block reconciliation. The reason is kept.
reverse_line_dialog.title: Reverse posting
reverse_line_dialog.description: The movement written from this line (and its fee) is reversed, on the movement's day while it is open, otherwise today. The line goes back to pending.
reverse_line_dialog.description_transfer: Both legs of the transfer are reversed, on the movement's day while it is open, otherwise today. The line goes back to pending.
validation.period_order: Period end cannot be before period start.
